summary: As of 2026-10-31 Nebius's billing documentation no longer states the $1 trial credit, so its current availability is unconfirmed. Nebius Token Factory previously documented $1 in trial credit upon first sign-up, valid for 30 days. Onboarding requires a billing account with a bank card and cannot be completed without it. Usage debits the balance in real time; the card is automatically charged to clear a negative balance at the start of the month or when the configured billing threshold is reached. This is a small trial credit, not a guarantee of zero-cost continued usage. Monitor usage, balance and billing settings; no fixed campaign end date is stated.
claim_steps: Sign up for a Nebius Token Factory account.
During onboarding, create a billing account — billing setup is mandatory and you cannot complete onboarding without it.
Set up the billing account with a bank card, which is required.
Check your balance after onboarding: the docs stated a $1 trial credit valid for 30 days through 2026-10-30, but the billing page no longer mentions it, so do not assume it is granted.
Monitor usage and balance: the card automatically settles a negative balance at month start or the configured billing threshold. Stop chargeable usage if you do not intend to pay beyond the trial.

social_proof.title: Billing & Consumption - Nebius Token Factory documentation (trial-credit sentence captured through 2026-10-30; removed 2026-10-31)
social_proof.text: When you sign up for Nebius Token Factory, you are prompted to create a billing account during onboarding. Billing setup is mandatory—you cannot complete onboarding without it. Setting up a billing account requires a bank card. Upon first sign-up, you receive $1 in trial credit, valid for 30 days.
